_note: External-beam radiotherapy units in Finland and the unit that serves each wellbeing services county, compiled by hand on 2026-11-14 from each unit's own service page or the county's own plan. lat and lon are the hospital's location, to about 1 km. A county served by more than one unit lists them all; the distance is to the nearest of them. A county marked not_verified has no public source that we found; the app shows no unit and no distance for it.
